audit.whatIsWrong: The chart hands Levels 2, 3 and First item to Vladimir and calls 4-5 and 6 'Skill', while every whys[] entry for those rows says Maokai bullies an escapeless Vlad. The packet flags the opposite defect (chart too generous to Maokai overall), but the stage-level answer the page renders currently disagrees with its own prose.
audit.why: Vladimir has no Sanguine Pool until 3 and it is 28s at rank 1, so a point-and-click Twisted Advance at 2 cannot be dodged. He is genuinely behind until his first AP item. The 45.67% win rate comes from the late game, which the chart already gives him.
audit.corrected: Levels 2-3 and 4-5 and 6 to Maokai, First item to Skill (his first AP item pulls it level), 2+ items stays Vladimir and drops to 3/10.

audit.why: Spike order holds: Maokai at 2-3 and 6, Vladimir at Sanguine Pool (level 3), first AP item, and hard from two items onward where Crimson Pact's HP-to-AP conversion makes his drain out-pace Sap Magic.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sanguine Pool is described only as 'Dodges your combo. Bait it.' — no duration, no cooldown — and the reason it dodges (Twisted Advance is a targeted dash, so untargetability cancels it outright) is never stated. Crimson Pact is never mentioned at all despite deciding your build.
audit.why: Pool is 2 seconds of untargetability on 28/25/22/19/16s. Twisted Advance targets a champion, so pool voids both the dash and the root; Nature's Grasp's root likewise cannot land on an untargetable Vlad. Crimson Pact gives him 1 AP per 30 bonus HP, so he is an HP stacker who converts your own itemisation logic into damage.
audit.corrected: Duration and cooldown added to tldr and dosFull[0].d; the targeted-dash reason added to dontsFull[0].d; Crimson Pact added to dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Riot's own text for Tides of Blood says the released blood 'can be blocked by enemy units', which the page never uses.
audit.why: If units in the way absorb it, keeping the minion wave or a sapling between you and Vlad reduces his only ranged chip. Not written into the page text because the kit does not confirm whether saplings count as blockers.
audit.corrected: Logged only; no page text asserts it.

edits.before: Build MR — W-root him, out-sustain his early. Maokai wins the Sanguine Pool cooldown windows.
edits.after: Build MR — W-root him at 2 before pool exists. You own the 28s Sanguine Pool windows.

edits.before: W root is your engage AND your peel — spend it once per fight. Only take the trade when Vladimir's Sanguine Pool is down.
edits.after: Twisted Advance is point-and-click and Sanguine Pool does not exist until 3 — root him, Q the knockback, heal it with Sap Magic.

edits.before: Dodges your combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Pool is 2s untargetable, 28s at rank 1 — bait it, then commit.

edits.before: That is Vladimir's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Pool goes untargetable for 2s and voids W root and R alike — never open into it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Crimson Pact turns HP into AP — raw HP alone loses the race.

notes: phases[4].why on disk contains a curly apostrophe (Nature’s Grasp); not edited. Tides of Blood being body-blockable by units is in Riot's text but I could not confirm saplings block it, so it stayed out of the page — see unverified.
